skills.name: AURA 你画我猜
skills.description_zh: 和 Agent 玩六回合你画我猜，双方各猜三次，支持逐笔作画、计分和硬件能力诚实降级。
skills.description_en: Play six rounds of draw-and-guess with three guesses per side, progressive drawing, scoring, and honest hardware fallbacks.
skills.author: FrontierX AuraOS
skills.description: Play six rounds of draw-and-guess with three guesses per side, progressive drawing, scoring, and honest hardware fallbacks.

skills.name: AURA 方舟对决
skills.description_zh: 安装、启动、停止并检查 AURA 方舟对决双人战术桌游。
skills.description_en: Install, start, stop, and inspect the AURA Dual Core Twin tactical board game.
skills.author: FrontierX AuraOS
skills.description: Install, start, stop, and inspect the AURA Dual Core Twin tactical board game.

skills.name: AURA 文字冒险
skills.description_zh: 与 AURA 结伴探索 5×5 固定地牢、获取普通长剑并完成确定性回合制战斗。
skills.description_en: Explore a fixed 5x5 dungeon with AURA, collect a longsword, and complete deterministic turn-based combat.
skills.author: FrontierX AuraOS
skills.description: Explore a fixed 5x5 dungeon with AURA, collect a longsword, and complete deterministic turn-based combat.

skills.name: 代码审查员
skills.description_zh: 提交一段代码，帮你做快速审查——找 bug、安全漏洞、性能问题和可读性改进。
skills.description_en: Submit a code snippet for quick review — bugs, security, performance, and readability feedback.
skills.author: Aura Community
skills.description: Submit a code snippet for quick review — bugs, security, performance, and readability feedback.

skills.name: 每日日记助手
skills.description_zh: 帮你回顾一天，用结构化模板写一篇日记。可自由聊天也可以按时间线+情绪梳理。
skills.description_en: Reflect on your day and compose a structured journal entry with timeline and emotional notes.
skills.author: Aura Community
skills.description: Reflect on your day and compose a structured journal entry with timeline and emotional notes.

skills.name: 夸夸群主
skills.description_zh: 一个热情到夸张的啦啦队长人格，无论你做了什么都能找出八百个角度夸你。能量满到溢出。
skills.description_en: An outrageously enthusiastic cheerleader persona — finds infinite angles to hype you up. Pure chaotic positive energy.
skills.author: Aura Community
skills.description: An outrageously enthusiastic cheerleader persona — finds infinite angles to hype you up. Pure chaotic positive energy.

skills.name: 表情包生成器
skills.description_zh: 给一个场景或情绪，帮你生成搞笑中文表情包的文字配词（表情包文案生成）。
skills.description_en: Generate witty Chinese meme captions for any situation or emotion you describe.
skills.author: Aura Community
skills.description: Generate witty Chinese meme captions for any situation or emotion you describe.

skills.name: room_spin_scan
skills.description_zh: 原地分段旋转，每转一小段就拍照，并用视觉解说周围环境（离散抓拍，中间会停）。
skills.description_en: Spin in place in short segments, capture a photo after each turn, and narrate what is around (discrete snapshots with brief pauses).
skills.description: Spin in place in short segments, capture a photo after each turn, and narrate what is around (discrete snapshots with brief pauses).

skills.name: 严厉老师
skills.description_zh: 一位要求严格、说话不留情面的老师人格。说话直来直去，不满意就批评，做得好也惜字如金地夸一句。
skills.description_en: A strict, no-nonsense teacher who criticizes freely and praises sparingly. Pushes you hard because they know you can do better.
skills.author: Aura Community

skills.name: 禅意大师
skills.description_zh: 一位话少但有深度的智者，用禅意短句回答一切。不说话则已，一开口让人想半天。
skills.description_en: A Zen master who speaks in short, philosophical koans. Says little, but every word lingers.
